sa: निहता ब्रह्मतेजोभिरहन्यहनि राक्षसाः। ततः पाण्डुरमेघाभं क्षीरोदं नाम सागरम्॥
en: Then wilt you, O you that are hard to repress, proceeding, view the sea named Kșiroda, having the hue of pale clouds, and looking like a necklace, because of the ripples (on its surface).

sa: पुजितोऽहं त्वया ब्रह्मन् पूजाण सुसत्कृतः। श्रूयतामभिधास्यामि वाक्यं वाक्यविशारद॥
en: Received and excellently entertained have I been by you, O Brāhmaṇa, who thyself art worthy of being honoured. Do you, O you conversant with speech, listen to me. I will tell you a word.

sa: दिव्यचन्दनदिग्धाङ्गान् दिव्याभरणभूषितान्। द्रक्ष्यस्यभिहतान् भूमौ तव दोषात्तु तु राक्षसान्॥
en: Thus shall you witness that for your own folly the rangers of the night, adorned with celestial ornaments and having their body pasted with sandal, have been killed and brought down to the earth.

sa: निकूलवृक्षमासाद्य दिव्यं सत्योपयाचनम्। अभिगम्याभिवाद्यं तं कुलिङ्गां प्राविशन् पुरीम्॥
en: Then on the western bank of the stream, coming upon a tree called Satyopayācana presided by a deity, and bowing down to the tree and going round it, they entered the city of Kulinga.

sa: अरोगस्तरुणो वाग्मी वपुष्मान् देशकालवित्। लोके पुरुषसारज्ञः साधुरेको विनिर्मितः॥
en: And he was free from ailments, and of young years; and endued with eloquence; and of an excellent person; and versed in season and place; and discerned character, the one honest person ever created.

sa: उपरिष्टाच्छरीरेण च्छायया चावगाढया। सागरे मारुताविष्टा नौरिवासीत् तदा कपिः॥
en: As he coursed above, on account of the reflection cast by his body (on the boson of the deep), the monkey* by his progress, looked link a bark swayed by the breeze. *Under water.

sa: ते द्विजास्त्रिविधं वृद्धा ज्ञानेन वयसौजसा। वय:प्रकम्पशिरसो दूरादूचुरिदं वचः॥
en: The three kinds of the twice-born ones, viz., those old by virtue, respectively, of age, wisdom, and ascetic energy, the old folks with their heads shaking through length of years, cried from a distance.

sa: अभिवर्षति कामैर्यः पर्जन्यः पृथिवीमिव। स कामपाशपर्यस्तो महातेजा महीपतिः॥
en: That highly effulgent lord of earth who will satisfy the world with the fulfilment of its desires like to rain spreading in showers over the earth, is himself now shackled with desires to Kaikeyi.

sa: स्त्वया वृतः केकयराजपुत्रि। विभूषितेयं प्रतिकर्मनित्या वसत्वरण्ये सह राघवेण॥
en: O daughter of king Kekaya, you have asked for the abode of Rāma in the woods, and decked out in ornaments let Sītā daily engaged in adorning herself, reside in the forest with Rāghava.

sa: न शक्तस्त्वं बलाद्धर्तुं वैदेहीं मम पश्यतः। हेतुभिर्यायसंयुक्तैर्बुवां वेदश्रुतीमिव॥
en: As it is not easy to destroy, by the reasonings of Logic, Vedas and Śrutis containing eternal and immutable truths, so you shall not be able to carry away Vaidehi by force before me.

sa: बह्वीश्च विविधाकारा रूपयौवनगर्विताः। स्त्रियः सुग्रीवभवने ददर्श स महाबलः॥
en: And that highly powerful one beheld in the abode of Sugrīva many a beautiful damsel proud of their youth and beauty sprung from respectable families, adorned with splendid ornaments, engaged in stringing excellent garlands.

sa: बलिषड्भागमुद्धत्य नृपस्यारक्षितुः प्रजाः। अधर्मो योऽस्य सोऽस्यास्तु यस्यार्योऽनुमते गतः॥
en: May the person that had approved the exile of the noble one to the woods, reap the sin of his that having taken a sixth pare of their incomes, does not protect his subjects!

sa: सर्वे सुकृतकर्माणः सर्वे धर्मपरायणाः। पशुभूता नरेन्द्रस्य तृप्तिमग्नेः प्रयच्छत॥
en: You are all of virtuous deeds, you are all engaged in the observance of righteousness, do you confer satisfaction upon Agni by one of you becoming the (sacrificial) beast of the lord of men.

sa: सत्यवादी महेष्वासो वृद्धसेवी जितेन्द्रियः॥ स्मितपूर्वाभिभाषी चार्धे सर्वात्मनाश्रितः। सम्यग्योक्ता श्रेयसां च न विगृह्यकथारुचिः॥
en: He speaks the truth, and is a mighty bowman. He ministers to the aged, and has controlled his senses. He preludes his speech with a smile, and is established in righteousness with his whole soul. he entirely brings about good, and he takes no delight in bandying words after a quarrel.

sa: सोऽयं ब्राह्मणभूयिष्ठो वानप्रस्थगणो महान्। त्वंन्नाथोऽनाथवद् राम राक्षसैर्हन्यते भृशम्॥
en: O Rāma, this many Brahmanas-this great body of men that have assumed the Vānaprastha mode of life, although having you for their lord, are being sorely troubled by Rákşasas, as if they had none.

sa: सामन्तराजसंधैश्च बलिकर्मभिरावृताम्। नानादेशनिवासैश्च वणिग्भिरुपशोभिताम्॥
en: It was thronged with neighbouring kings come to pay tribute, and inhabited by merchants from various countries.

sa: पद्मवर्णं सुकेशान्तं पद्मनिःश्वासमुत्तमम्। कदा द्रक्ष्यामि रामस्य वदनं पुष्करेक्षणम्॥
en: When shall I behold Rāma's countenance hued like the lotus, with his hair ending beautifully (in curls), and his breath impregnated with the fine perfume of the lotus, and his eyes resembling lotus leaves?

sa: उषितास्मि तवागारे दीर्घकालं समर्चिता। तदिदं वैरमुत्पन्नं सुखमाशु व्रजाम्यहम्॥
en: I have lived in your house for a long time, respected all along by you. a cause of eninity, however, has at last taken place. I should, therefore, quit this place without any hesitation.

sa: स चेन्ममार संजय चतुर्भद्रतरस्त्वया। पुत्रात् पुण्यतरश्चैव मा पुत्रमनुतप्यथाः॥
en: When he, O Srinjaya, who was far superior to you in the four principal attributes and who was purer than your son met with death, do not grieve for your son who is dead.

sa: शूलिने त्रिदशेशाय त्र्यम्बकाय महात्मने। भस्मदिग्धाङ्गलिङ्गाय तस्मै रुद्रात्मने नमः॥
en: You carry the trident, you are the lord of the celestials, you have three eyes, and you are great. Your body is always besmeared with ashes. Salutations to you in your form of Rudra.

sa: ददर्श सा बुद्धिमती दूरादपि यथान्तिके। रणाजिरं नृवीराणामद्भुतं लोमहर्षणम्॥
en: The highly intelligent Kuru dame saw, from a distance, but as if from a near point, that field of battle, terrible to look at and full of wonderful sights, of those foremost of warriors.

sa: अग्राह्यं चक्षुषा सूक्ष्ममनिर्देश्यं च तद्गिरा। कर्महेतुपुरस्कारं भूतेषु परिवर्तते।१९।।
en: Unseen by the eye, highly subtile, and indescribable by words, it goes on in a round (of rebirths) among the creatures of the Earth, keeping before it that which is the root of action.

sa: यस्य रुक्ममयी माला शिरस्येषा विराजते। श्वापदैर्भक्ष्यमाणस्य शोभयन्तीव मूर्धजान्॥
en: Look at the golden and shining garland that he still wears on his head. Though the body is being devoroured by beasts of prey, that garland still adorns the beautiful hairs on his head.

sa: आकाङ्क्षन्नात्मनो राज्यं राज्ये स्थितिमकोपयन्। अदत्तमेवाददीत दातुर्वित्तं ममेति च॥
en: Desirous of preserving his rule, the king, O monarch, without making his subjects indignant and rebellious may take what is not given to him by the owner, of his own accord, saying,-This is mine.

sa: स चन्ममार संजय चतुर्भद्रतरस्त्वया। पुत्रात् पुण्यतरश्चैव मा पुत्रमनुतप्यथाः॥
en: When even that king, O Srinjaya who was superior to you in religious merit, knowledge, renunciation, and wealth, and who was purer than your son, met with death, do not grieve for your son.

sa: क्षत्रियाणां महाराज संग्रामे निधनं मतम्। विशिष्टं बहुभिर्यज्ञैः क्षत्रधर्ममंनुस्मर॥
en: O king, as regards Kshatriyas, death in battle is regarded more meritorious for them than the celebration of various sacrifices. it is so laid down in the ordinance that describes the duties of Kshatriyas.

sa: अन्योन्कृतवैराणां संवासान्मृदुतां गतम्। नैव तिष्ठति तद् वैरं पुष्करस्थमिवोदकम्॥
en: Amongst persons who have ir jured one another, living together blunts the sharpness of enmily. Indeed, that enmity does not last long, but disappears quickly like water poured upon the leaf of a louts.

sa: ते त्वां तात निषेवेयुर्याबदाईकपाणयः॥ कुलीनाशीलसम्पन्नानिङ्गितज्ञाननिष्ठुरान्। देशकालविधानज्ञान् भर्तृकार्यहितैषिणः॥ नित्यमर्थेषु सर्वेषु राजा कुर्वीत मन्त्रिणः।
en: Those who are of good-birth and good behaviour, who can interpret all sings and gestures, who are shorn of cruelty, who know the requirements of place and time, who always seek the well-being of their master in all works, should be appointed as ministers by the king in all his affairs.

sa: हेतुमात्रमिदं तस्य विहितं भरतर्षभ। यद्धन्ति भूतैर्भूतानि तदस्मै रूपमैश्वरम्॥
en: This battle, O foremost of Bharata's race, was only an occasion ordained by him. He brought out the destruction of creatures through the instrumentality of Time. In this manner it displays its irresistible power.

sa: स चेन्ममार संजय चतुर्भद्रतरस्त्वया। पुत्रात् पुण्यतरश्चैव मा पुत्रमनुतप्यथाः॥
en: When even be, O Srinjaya, who was far superior to you in the four attributes and who was purer than your son, met with death, do not grieve for your son who is dead.

sa: जगाम धृतराष्ट्रस्य भवनं ब्राह्मणोत्तमः।
en: Saying it the greatly energetic Vaka, that best of Brahmanas, then went to the palace of Dhritarashtra.

sa: आपत्सु विहितं स्तैन्यं विशिष्टसमहीनताः। विप्रेण प्राणरक्षार्थ कर्तव्यमिति निश्चयः॥
en: Theft is sanctioned in an hour of distress for even a great man. It will not divest him of his eminence. Even a Brahmana for saving his life may do it. This is certain.

sa: न शोचन्न पहष्यंश्च तुल्यनिन्दात्मसंस्तुतिः। निराशीर्निर्ममो भूत्वा निर्द्वन्द्वो निष्परिग्रहः॥
en: Without being over-grieved, or over-joyed, and considering censure and applause, hope and affection, in the same light and conquering the pairs of opposites, I shall live, casting off all the things of the world.

sa: बलवन्तं करिष्यामि प्रणोत्स्याम्यशुभानि तु। तपोभिर्विद्यया चैव ज्योतीषीव महत्तमः॥
en: Continuing to live I shall try to acquire virtue and shall dissipate by penances and by knowledge the calamities which have befallen me, like the luminaries of the sky destroying even the thickest darkness.

sa: भोजनादेव लोकांस्त्रींस्त्रायन्ते महतो भयात्। दीप: सर्वस्य लोकस्य चक्षुश्चक्षुष्मतामपि॥
en: By the very food they eat, they rescue the three worlds from great feat. They are, as it were, the Island for all worlds. They are the cyes of all persons gifted with sight.

sa: भवता कथितं ह्येतच्छ्रद्दधे चाहमच्युत। भूयस्तु मे समुत्पन्ना बुद्धिरव्यक्तदर्शनात्॥
en: You have described Vritra's acts. I too have heard you in full faith. Because, on account of my seeing that one point is unintelligible that my curiosity has been roused for asking you again.

sa: नार्हस्येवं वरारोहे प्रत्याख्यातुं वरानने। मां मन्मथसमाविष्टं त्वत्कृते चारुहासिनि॥
en: O fair faced damsel of excellent hips, it is not seemly on your part thus to disregarded me who am quite under the influence of Cupid on your account, O you of sweet smiles.

sa: अनभ्याहतचित्त स्यादनभ्याहतवाग् भवेत्। निर्मुक्तः सर्वपापेभ्यो निरमित्रस्य किं भयम्॥
en: He should purify his heart of all shortcomings. He should purify his speech of all faults. He should purge himself of all sins. Shorn as he is of enemies what fear can attack him.

sa: एवं सम्पादयन्तस्ते तदान्योन्यं महारथाः। विराटनगरे चेरुः पुनर्गर्भधृता इव॥
en: They, the mighty warriors, then looking after the interest of one another, lived in the city of Virata in such a manner, as if they were once more in the house of their mother.

sa: गौतम उवाच जीवत्वहंकृतो बुद्ध्या विषमेणासमेन सः। कर्षको मत्सरी चास्तु यस्ते हरति पुष्करम्॥
en: Gautama said Let him who has stolen your stalks live, all things, with an understanding that does not see all creatures with an equal eye, and always giving way to the influence of desire and anger. Let him be a cultivator of the soil, and let him be moved by malice.

sa: द्रोणद्रौणिकृपैश्चैव गन्ता पार्थो यमक्षयम्। पितामहोऽपि गाङ्गेयः शान्तनोरधि भारत॥
en: And by Drona, his son and Kripa, this son of Pritha will go to the region of the dead. Born of Ganga, our grandfather, too, is superior to the son of Shantanu, O Bharata.

sa: तेषामेको महानासीत् सर्वमल्लानथाह्वयत्। आवल्गमानं तं रङ्गे नोपतिष्ठति कश्चन॥
en: Amongst them there was one who was the greatest of all and challenged all other combatants to a wrestle; there was none that ventured to encounter him as he strided over in the arena.

sa: आढ्योऽभिजनवानस्मि कोऽन्योऽस्ति सदृशो मया। अक्ष्ये दास्यामि मोदिष्य इत्यज्ञानविमोहिताः॥
en: I am wealthy, I am nobly born, who is there in this world as I am, I shall sacrifice, I shall make gifts, I shall be merry, (thus say the demoniac), deluded by ignorance.

sa: धर्मच्छद्या ह्ययं पापो वृथाचारपरिग्रहः॥ कार्यार्थ भोजनार्थेषु व्रतेषु कृतवाश्रमम्।
en: At heart a wretch, he has disguised himself by assuming the grab of virtue. His conduct is really vicious. For serving his own purpose he had practised austerities in matters of diet and vows.

sa: प्रहसंश्चास्य चिच्छेद कार्मुकं रिपुभीषणम्। नागं मणिमयं चैव शरैर्ध्वजमपातयत्॥
en: Then smiling he cut-off Duryodhana's bow that used to inspire terror into the hearts of the enemy. Then with his arrows, he cut down the latter's standard and the elephant of pearls embossed thereon.

sa: न स दृश्यो मुनिगणैस्तथा देवैः सवासवैः। गन्धर्वयक्षसिद्धैर्वा नरनारायणादृते॥
en: He is invisible by the group of Munis as also by the gods along with Vasava and by the Gandharvas and Yakshas who have attained salvation, indeed by all save by Nara and Narayana.

sa: पश्चात्तु शैलवत् पेतुस्ते गजाः सह सादिभिः। वज्रिवज्रप्रमथिता यथैवाद्रिचयास्तथा॥
en: After a short while, the elephants that resembled hill, along with those riding upon them, tumbled down upon the ground even as the large mountains broken down by the thunder-bolt fall upon the ground.

sa: तेन पादतलक्रान्ता रम्येषु गिरिसानुषु ॥ सघोषाः समशीर्यन्त शिलाञ्चूर्णीकृतास्ततः।
en: And on the lovely level of that mountain, the crags, crushed with sounds under the tread of that one burning to behold Rāma and wrought up with excess of joy, were scattered all round.

sa: ज्वलितार्केन्दुनक्षत्रं निर्विशेषदिनक्षयम्। अहोरात्रं मया दृष्टं तद् भयाय भविष्यति॥
en: I have seen the sun, the moon and the stars ablaze. No difference can be found in them in the evening, I have seen this all day and all night. All this forebodes evil.

sa: तस्यातिमानुषं कर्म दृष्ट्वान्यैरसमं रणे॥ युक्तं योगेन योगज्ञास्तावकाः समपूजयन्।
en: Beholding that superhuman feat achieved by him in battle-feat which was incapable of being achieved by others and which displayed great tact, those amongst your warriors who were judges of skill, highly praised it.

sa: स सिंहदंष्ट्रो जानुभ्यां पतितोऽमितविक्रमः। शरादितः सात्यकिना रथोपस्थे नरर्षभः॥
en: That one of infinite prowess and of teeth resembling those of the lion, that foremost of men, then fell on his knees on the terrace of his car, being afflicted by arrows of Satyaki.

sa: चतुर्णामाश्रमाणां हि गार्हस्थ्यं श्रेष्ठमुत्तमम्। आहुर्धर्मज्ञ धर्मज्ञास्तं कथं त्यक्तुमिच्छसि॥
en: O you cognizant of morality, those versed in duty say that of the four modes of life, the life of the householder is the foremost. Why then do you wish to renounce the same?

sa: ते पञ्च पाञ्चालरथप्रवीरा वैकर्तनं कर्णमभिद्रवन्तः। पार्षतेन।॥ धैर्यात् कृतात्मानमिवेन्द्रियार्थाः॥
en: As the objects of senses cannot extract the purity out of a holy man, so those five best Panchala warriors, though they tried their utmost, could not shake Vaikartana (Karna) from off his car.

sa: हरिणा चन्दनेनाङ्गमुपलिप्य महाभुजः। स्रग्वी चाक्लिष्टवसनः प्राङ्मुखः प्राञ्जलिः स्थितः।।
en: Thereafter that mighty-armed one, having smeared his body with the paste of Hari-sandal and decorated his person with garlands and flowers and dressed in stainless garments, sat with his palms folded, facing the east.

sa: प्रभिन्नगजसंकाशास्तोयशोणितधारिणः। आकाशं तदनाकाशं चक्रुभीमाम्बुवाहकाः॥
en: And terrific clouds surcharged with water and blood, and resembling elephants with rent temples, enveloped the sky.

sa: स्थण्डिलेषु शयानानां गृहाणि शयनानि च। चीरवल्कलसंवीते वासांस्याभरणानि च॥
en: Those who use the sacrificial platform as their only bed, obtain palatial mansions and beds (in subsequent births). He who wears only rags and barks of trees for dress, gets good apparel and ornaments.

sa: तं सर्वदमनेत्याहुर्द्विजास्तेनास्य कर्मणा। तं प्रत्यषेधज्जननी मा सत्त्वानि विजीजहि॥
en: For those feats of his, the regenerate sages residing there used to call him Sarvadamana (or the subduer of all). But at last his mother forbade him do so, saying-'Do not torture animals thus.'

sa: तस्मिन्नन्तर्हिते चाहमुपांशुव्रतमाचरम्॥ यत्किचिद् ब्राह्मणो ब्रूयात् सर्वं कुर्यामिति प्रभो।
en: After his disappearance, I began to follow the vow of uttering certain Mantras silently without being heard by anybody. From that day I resolved to do whatever commands I should receive from the Brahmanas.

sa: अकम्पन्नहुषं स्थानादं दृष्ट्वा बलनिषूदनः। तेजोनं सर्वभूतानां वरदानाच्च दुःसहम्॥
en: Form that place the slayer of Bala saw Nahusha, who was not afraid of him and who absorbed the power of all beings and who could not be approached through the boon granted him.

sa: अदैवं दैवतं कुर्युर्दैवतं चाप्यदैवतम्। लोकानन्यान् सृजेयुस्ते लोकपालांश्च कोपिताः॥
en: They would make gods of those who are not gods, and not gods of those who are gods. Enraged, they can create other worlds and other Regents of the worlds than those who exist.

sa: रक्षां चैव विधास्यामि वानराद्रजनीचर। नागमिष्यति ते दुःखं किंचिदात्मापराधजम्॥
en: O ranger of the night, I shall deliver (the Rāks asas) from the monkeys; and you shall not have to suffer in the least in consequence of your transgression.* *i.e. the ravishment of Sitā

sa: जातरूपपरिच्छन्नां प्रगृह्य महतीं गदाम्॥ न्यवधीत् तावकान् सर्वान् दण्डपाणिरिवान्तकः।
en: Armed with his heavy mace made entirely of iron and adorned with gold and resembling the Destroyer himself at the end of Yuga, Bhima slew them all like Yama destroying crcatures with his club.

sa: अत्र नानाविधाकारास्तिमयो नैकरूपिणः। अप्सु सोमप्रभां पीत्वा वसन्ति जलचारिणः॥
en: Here aquatic animals of many species and shapes and fishes of different sorts, such as Timi and others, live, subsisting on a drink from the water which is like the beams of the moon.

sa: सर्वभूतहितो मैत्रस्तस्मान्नोद्विजते जनः। समुद्र इव गम्भीरः प्रज्ञातृप्तः प्रशाम्यति॥
en: People are not made unhappy by him who makes all creatures his friends and seeks their good; he is calm and grave as the ocean and is pleased (with everything) owing to his wisdom.

sa: असूयन्ति हि राजानो नराननृतवादिनः। तथैव चावमन्यन्ते नरान् पण्डितमानिनः॥
en: One should not reveal to others any lie, that has been told by the king for he is annoyed with those who report his lies and also despise those who regard themselves as learned.

sa: शृण्वतां पार्थिवेन्द्राणामन्येषां चैव सर्वशः। वासुदेवमभिप्रेक्ष्य धर्मराजं च पाण्डवम्॥
en: And in the hearing of those chief among the rulers of the earth, and all others who were there and with his eyes on Vasudeva and on the virtuous king the son of Pandu,

sa: ऐन्द्रं स प्रार्थयत् स्थान् विश्वरूपो महाद्युतिः। तैस्त्रिभिर्वदनै।रैः सूर्येन्दुज्वलनोपमैः॥
en: The place, occupied by Indra, was desired by this mysterious personage, who was as it were the image of the universe and had three awful faces comparable to the sun, the moon and fire.

sa: यातेषु कुरुष क्षत्ता दाशार्हमपराजितम्। अभ्यर्चयामास तदा सर्वकामैः प्रयत्नवान्॥
en: The Kurus having departed, the Khattva Vidura paid due honours to the scion of the Dasharha race who had never met with a defeat and then made special endeavours to meet all his wishes.

sa: विष्णुनाश्वशिरः प्राप्य तथादित्यां निवत्स्यता। गर्भ वधार्थं दैत्यानामज्ञातेनोषितं चिरम्॥
en: And for the purpose of killing the Danavas Lord Vishnu passed a long time indisguise in the womb of Aditi (mother of gods) before taking his birth simulating the form of the Hayagriva (horse-necked).

sa: युधिष्ठिर उवाच ज्ञानं तत्त्वार्थसम्बोधः शमश्चित्तप्रशान्तता। दया सर्वसुखैषित्वमार्जवं समचित्तता॥
en: Yudhishthira replied A thorough grasp of divinity is true knowledge, peacefulness of the mind is tranquility, kindness consists in a desire to do good to all. And equanimity of the mind is (true) simplicity.

sa: वर्तामहे त्वयि च तां त्वं च वर्तस्व नस्तथा। पित्रा स्थापयितव्या हि वयमुत्पथमास्थिताः॥
en: We act towards you in that way (the way in which younger should behave towards their elders); you also act towards us in the same way (the way in which elders should behave towards their youngers). If we follow the wrong way, then should we be set right by our father.

sa: त्वया चतुर्णां भ्रातृणामभयं शत्रुकर्शन। दत्तं तत् प्रतिजानीहि संगरप्रतिमोचनम्॥
en: By you has the pledge of safety been given to four of your brothers, O grinder of foes; remember the boon therefore which you have granted when weapons are being shot in the battle.

sa: नानुक्रोशान्न कार्पण्यान्न च धर्माथकाराणात्। अलं कर्तुं धार्तराष्ट्रास्तव काममरिंदम्॥
en: Not out of kindness, nor out of cowardice and not even from a desire to gain virtue or profit will the son of Dhritarashtra do as you wish, O you chastiser of your foes.

sa: अत्र गोवतिनो विप्राः स्वाध्यायम्नायकर्शिताः। त्यक्तप्राण जितस्वर्गा निवसन्ति महर्षयः॥
en: Here live the great Rishis those Brahmanas attached to the vow, called go, who have been emaciated with the recitation of the Vedas and who abandoning the pleasures of this life have secured heaven.

sa: एतस्मिंस्तु तथाभूते नान्यं हिंसित्तमुत्सहे। क्रीडसे कामकारेण देवराज यथेच्छकम्॥
en: I dare not now kill another of the species, which is used such (i.e., on whom you have granted a boon); you play as you like, of your own will, O king the gods.

sa: अस्ति मे बलमित्येव सहसा त्वं तितीर्षसि। सग्राहनक्रमकरं गङ्गावेगमिवोर्णगे॥
en: "I have got an army” with this thought you desire to overcome the Pandavas as the current of the Ganga flows into the ocean, full of sharks, alligators and crocodiles during the rainy season.

sa: यथोदपाने महति सर्वतः सम्प्लुतोदके। एवं सर्वेषु वेदेषु आत्मानमनुजानतः॥
en: As one can do as well with a well as with a large tank, so one who knows the supreme should can do as well with his own knowledge as with the entire Veda.

sa: तदर्धमासं पिबति संचित्य भ्रमरो मधु। ईशानः सर्वभूतेषु हरिर्भूतमकल्पयत्। योगिनस्तं प्रपश्यन्ति भगवन्तं सनातनम्॥
en: The being who, like a bee sucking honey only for half the month, enjoys only one-half of the fruits of his actions and has to come back to the world to enjoy the other half and is present in all creatures ordains sacrifices. The ascetics perceive that Lord who is immortal.

sa: बुद्धिश्रेष्ठानि कर्माणि बाहुमध्यानि भारत। तानि जवाजघन्यानि भारप्रत्यवराणि च॥
en: Acts performed by means of the intellect are the best; those performed by the arms come next; O Bharata, those by the things are bad; while those performed by carrying loads are the worst.

sa: एवंप्रायश्च लोकोऽयं मनुष्याः शक्तिपेशलाः। सन्तस्त्वेवाप्यमित्रेषु दयां प्राप्तेषु कुर्वते॥
en: In this world, it is generally the case that men here are destitute of energy and skill. (But) the righteous show mercy even to their enemies when the latter throw themselves into the protection.

sa: अधर्मनिपुणा मूढा लोके मायाविशारदाः। न मान्यं मानयिष्यन्ति मान्यानामवमानिनः॥
en: Those wretches again in this world who are adepts at unrighteousness and at deceit do not respect those that are worthy of respect. On the contrary, they insult those who ought to be respected.

sa: शालस्कन्धो महाबाहुस्त्वां स्वजानो वृकोदरः। साम्नाभिवदतां चापि शान्तये भरतर्षभ॥
en: Let him, whose shoulders are broad as the trunk of Shala trees, Vrikodara, of long arms, embrace you and with good will greet you for the sake of peace, O best among the Bharatas.

sa: जयस्व राजधर्मेण उभौ लोकौ महाद्युते। दूतस्त्वां द्रष्टुमायातस्तपसा भास्करप्रभः॥
en: O you of great effulgence, observing the royal duties, may you acquire victory in both the worlds; one ambassador radiant like the sun by virtue of his asceticism, has come here to visit you.

sa: यदा तु विविधोपायैः संवृतैर्विवृतैरपि। नाशकद्विनिहन्तुं तान्दैवभाव्यर्थरक्षितान्॥ ततः संमन्त्र्य सचिवैर्वृषदुःशानादिभिः। धृतराष्ट्रमनुज्ञाप्य जातुषं गृहमादिशत्॥
en: When Duryodhana found himself incapable of destroying the Pandavas who were protected by Fate and kept alive for graver objects, by various secret and open means he called together his councillors, Karna, son Dushasana and others. He then caused a house of lac to be built with the knowledge of Dhritarashtra.

sa: निकामवर्षाः स्फीताश्च आसञ्जनपदास्तथा। वार्धषी यज्ञसत्त्वानि गोरक्षं कर्षणं वणिक्॥
en: The rains were as much as could be desired and the kingdom became full of prosperity. Persons living on usury, things necessary for sacrifices, cattle-rearing, tillage, and trades, all and everything grew in prosperity.

sa: तस्य नामाकरोच्चैव पितामहसम: पिता। जरया संधितो यस्माज्जरासंधो भवत्वयम्॥
en: The father (the king) who was equal to the Grandsire, then bestowed a name on that child. As the (fragments of the body of the child) was united by Jara, he was named Jarasandha.

sa: त्रेताद्वापरयोः संधौ रामः शस्त्रभृतां वरः। असकृत्यार्थिव क्षत्रं जघानामर्षचोदितः॥
en: At the end of Treta and in the beginning of Dwapara Yuga, the greatest of all that ever wielded arms, Parashurama, being impatient of wrongs, repeatedly destroyed all the Kshatriya races of the world.

sa: नीलपीतासिदश्यामैः सितैलॊहितकैरपि। अवतानैस्तथा गुल्मैर्मञ्जरीजालधारिभिः॥
en: Many plants with blue, yellow, black, dark, white and red blossoms has formed themselves into excellent bowers.

sa: स्वस्तिवाच्याहतो विप्रान् प्रयाहि भरतर्षभ। दुर्हदामप्रहर्षाय सुहृदां नन्दनाय च॥
en: Yudhishthira said O best of the Bharata race, start but first cause the holy Brahmanas to utter benedictions on you, so that you may plunge your enemies into grief and make your friends happy.

sa: स्रष्टा हि जगतः कस्मान्न संबुध्यते भारत। ससुरासुरलोकानामशषेण मनोगतम्॥
en: O descendant of the Bharata race he is the creator of the universe, why should he not know fully what is in the minds of the creatures, including the very Devas and the Danavas?

sa: प्रसन्नसलिलैश्चापि ह्रदैर्दिव्यैर्विभूषितम्। दिव्यगन्धवहैः पुण्यैर्मारुतैरुपवीजितम्॥
en: It was adorned with many beautiful lakes of pure water; it was refreshed with sweet incense-carrying breezes.

sa: गच्छ त्वं जरितामेव यदर्थं परितप्यसे। चरिष्याम्यहमप्येका यथा कुपुरुषाश्रिता॥
en: Go to Jarita for whom your heart is so very sorrowful. As for myself, I shall roam alone, it would be a fit regard for me for having attached myself to a wicked man.

sa: वर्जयित्वा महात्मानं चिरजीविनमुत्तमम्॥ पितृभक्तस्तु यो विप्रो वरलब्धो महायशाः।
en: Excepting the great, immortal and excellent Markandeya, that learned Brahmana of great fame, who is ever devoted to the Pitris, none amongst them is conversant with the mysteries of the ordinances about the Pitris.

sa: सर्वांश्चैनाननुचरन् वत्सवच्चतुरः स्तनान्। न पावनतमं किंचित् सत्यादध्यगमं क्वचित्॥
en: Like a calf sucking all the four teets of its dam's udders, one should devote himself to the practice of all these virtues. I do not know whether anything exists more sacred than Truth.

sa: महाप्रज्ञा बुद्धिमती देवी धर्मार्थदर्शिनी। आगमापायतत्त्वज्ञा कच्चिदेषा न शोचति॥
en: She is endued with great wisdom. Endued with intelligence, that queen understands both virtue and profit. She is well conversant with the truths which relate to both prosperity and adversity. Does not still grieve?

sa: कथं स्यादवशेषो हि धुर्ययोरभ्यतीतयोः। यो नित्यमुपजीवामः क्षमिणौ पुरुषर्षभौ॥
en: When those two foremost of men, viz. Bhishma and Drona of forgiving nature who used to be our primary support, when they both have been killed, how can any thing remain of this kingdom?

sa: एतच्च मे बहुमतं यदुत्सृज्य नराधिपान्। मामेवमुपयातोऽसि भावि चैतदसंशयम्॥
en: This too is a mark of great respect for me that passing by many rulers of men you have come to me and without doubt this will be (i.e. your wishes shall be gratified.)

sa: संविभागो हि भूतानां सर्वेषामेव दृश्यते। तथैवापचमानेभ्यः प्रदेयं गृहमेधिना॥
en: All creatures are seen to divide their food among those that depend on them. So should person leading a domestic life give a share of his food to Brahmacharis who have given up cooking.

sa: विश्वामित्राय धर्मात्मन् षड्भिरश्वशतैः सह। ततोऽसि गतसम्मोहः कृतकृत्यो द्विजोत्तम॥
en: Namely, Vishvamitra, O virtuous-souled one, along with the six hundred horses; then will you be beyond the reach of grief and your desire will be successful, o best among the twice the twice born."

sa: त्वमगाधेऽप्लवे मग्नान् पाण्डवान् कुरुसागरे। समुद्धर प्लवो भूत्वा शङ्खचक्रगदाधर॥
en: O you the bearer of the conch, the discus and the mace, do you save the sons of Pandu sunk in the deep and boatless Kurn ocean, by becoming even a boat to them.

sa: वेगेन महता पार्थ पतन्नारायणोरसि॥ ततस्तत् तेजसाऽऽविष्टाः केशा नारायणस्य ह। बभूवुर्मुञ्जवर्णास्तु ततोऽहं मुञ्जकेशवान्॥
en: With great violence the dart then dropped upon the chest of Narayana. Attacked by the violence of that dart, the hair on the head of Narayana became green. In fact, on account of this change in the colour of my hair I came to be called by the name of Munjakesha.

sa: रथैविपरिधावद्भिर्गजैरश्चैश्च सारथे। कौशेयारुणसंकाशमेतदुद्भूयते रजः॥
en: O charioteer, behold a thick tawny cloud of dust raised by the flying cars, elephants and steeds.

sa: इति बहुविधमाकुलान्तरात्मा कृपणमतीव विलप्य कुम्भकर्णम्। स्तमनुजमिन्द्ररिपुं हतं विदित्वा॥
en: Having thus piteously and long lamented Kumbhakarna, the Ten-necked one, with his inmost soul overwhelmed with sorrow, and sore distressed in consequence of grief, fell down, knowing his brother—the enemy of Indra-slain in battle.

sa: गुणेष्वेते प्रकाशन्ते निर्गुणत्वात् ततः परम्। निवृत्तिलक्षणो धर्मस्तथाऽऽनन्त्याय कल्पते॥
en: What we perceive is displayed in attributes. That which is called Brahma, being without attributes, is superior to these. Abstention from acts constitutes the greatest religion. That religion is sure to bring on deathlessness.

sa: नवं जलं पर्वतधातुताम्रम्। मयूरकेकाभिरनुप्रयातं शैलापगाः शीघ्रतरं वहन्ति ॥
en: There speedily pass by the hill streams, being resounded with the cries of peacocks, carrying with the current Sarja and Kadamba flowers and having their coppery contents mixed with the metals of the mountain.

sa: यदा द्रक्ष्यसि संग्रामे श्वेताश्रं कृष्णसारथिम्। ऐन्द्रमस्त्रं विकुर्वाणमुभे चाप्यग्निमारुते॥
en: When you will see in the battle Arjuna, driving on a chariot drawn by white horses and driven by Krishna, making use of the Aindra weapon, as also the weapons of Agni and Marut.

sa: राजत्विजं स्नातकं च गुरुं श्वशुरमेव च।॥ अर्चयेन्मधुपर्केण परिसंवत्सरोषितान्।
en: The householder should adore with offerings of honey, etc., his king his priest, his preceptor, and his fatherinlaw, as also Snataka Brahmanas even if they were to live in his house for whole year.

sa: त्रैलोक्यगोप्ता गोविन्दो गोमार्गोऽमार्ग एव च। श्रेष्ठः स्थिरश्च स्थाणुश्च निष्कम्पः कम्प एव च॥
en: You are the protector of the three worlds, you are Govinda, you are the director of the senses, and you are incapable of being apprehended by the senses. You are the foremost of all creatures, you are fixed, you are immobile, you tremble not, you are of the form of trembling.

sa: पश्य पुत्रांस्तथा भ्रातृज्ञातीन् सम्बन्धिनस्तथा। त्वत्कृते न विनश्येयुरिमे भरतसत्तमाः॥
en: Look at your sons and at your brothers and at your kinsmen and other relations; let them not be destroyed by an act done by you, O you best among the race of Bharata.

sa: अश्विनाविन्दुममृतं वृत्तभूयौ तिरोधत्तामश्विनौ दासपत्नी। हित्वा गिरिमश्विनौ गा मुदा चरन्तौ तवृष्टिमह्ना प्रस्थितौ बलस्य॥
en: O Ashvinis, you are this universe of five elements. You are the objects that are enjoyed in this and the next world. Raise me beyond the influence of the five elements. You are the supreme Brahma, but you move on earth in forms and enjoy those pleasures that the senses give.

sa: तां सर्वशक्त्या प्रहितां सुशक्तिं युधिष्ठिरेणाप्रतिवार्यवीर्यम्। प्रतिग्रहायाभिननर्द शल्यः सम्यग्धुतामग्निरिवाज्यधाराम्॥
en: Shalya cried aloud and tried to catch that excellent dart of great energy hurled by Yudhishthira with all his strength even as a fire laps forth for catching the clarified butter poured over it.

sa: अकिंचनस्य शुद्धस्य उपपन्नस्य सर्वतः। अवेक्षमाणस्त्रील्लोकान् न तुल्यमिह लक्षये॥
en: Stretching my eyes on every part of the three worlds, I do not find the person who can be equal to a poor man of unblemished character and who is indifferent to worldly things.

sa: ततस्तस्मिन् मुहूर्तेऽथ राजोपरिचरस्तदा। अधो वै सम्बभूवाशु भूमेर्विवरगो नृप॥
en: After the Rishis had said these words, king Uparichara immediately dropped down, O king, and went down a hole in the Earth. At the command, however,. of Narayana, Vasu's memory did not leave him.

sa: भगवंस्तन्ममाचक्ष्व को वै स पुरुषोत्तमः। शूलपाणिर्मया हृष्टतेजसा सूर्यसंनिभः॥
en: O illustrious possessor of the six qualities the Bhagas, tell me who is that excellent of all male beings, whom I see armed with the trident and who resembles the Sun himself in effulgence.

sa: सच्चासच्चैव कौन्तेय मयाऽऽवेशितमात्मनि। पौष्करे ब्रह्मसदने सत्यं मामृषयो विदुः॥
en: The existent and the non-existent have been merged by me in my Soul. The Rishis living in Pushkara which is considered as the residence of Brahmana called me by the name of Truth. even

sa: स्वधर्मः परमस्तेषां वैश्यशूद्रं तदागमत्। पूजां च सर्ववर्णानां शूद्राश्चनुर्विशेषतः॥
en: And the greatest piety of the Vaiśyas and Śūdras at that time consisted of serving the Brāhmaṇas and Ksatriyas and specially for the Śūdras the highest religion was to serve people of all Varnas.

sa: प्रणिपातं च गच्छेत काले शत्रोर्बलीयसः। युक्तोऽस्य वधमन्विच्छेदप्रमत्तः प्रमाद्यतः॥
en: Occasionally the king should even prostrate himself before a powerful enemy. It is again desirable that acting with every care, he should try to bring about the victor's destruction when the latter becomes careless.

sa: एकपाद्बहुनेत्राय एकशीर्णे नमोऽस्तु ते। रुद्राय क्षुद्रलुब्धाय संविभागप्रियाय च॥
en: Salutations to you who have one leg and many eyes, and only one head; to you who are fierce, to you who are satisfied with little offerings, and you who are fond of equity.

sa: एष वीराष्टकः प्रोक्तः स्कन्दमातृगणोद्भवः। छागवक्त्रेण सहितो नवकः परिकीर्त्यते॥
en: He was regarded as the eighth hero born of the mothers of Skanda called 'Virashtaka. But he is known also as the Vira-navaka when the being with the face of a goat is included.

sa: एकवस्त्रा त्वधोनीवी रोदमाना रजस्वला। सभामागम्य पाञ्चालि श्वशुरस्याग्रतो भव॥
en: (Saying) "Panchali should appear before her father-in-law by coming to the Sabha, though she is weeping and attired in one piece of cloth with her naval exposed in consequence of her season having came.”

sa: साङ्गोपनिषदो वेदानधीते द्विजसत्तमः। स वृक्षमूले कस्मिंश्चिद् वेदानुच्चारयन् स्थितः॥
en: That foremost of the Brahmanas had finished the study of the Vedas with the Angas and the Upanishadas. On a certain day, he was reciting the Vedas, seated on the root of a tree.

sa: प्रकालयेद् दिशः सर्वाः प्रतोदेनेव सारथिः। प्रत्यमित्रश्रियं दीप्तां जिघृक्षुर्भरतर्षभ।॥
en: O best of the Bharata race, he, who is desirous of securing the blazing prosperity of his enemy, should bring all directions under his subjection, as the charioteer does his steeds with his whip.

sa: तत आयव्ययौ दृष्ट्वा समौ सममतिर्द्विजः। सर्वथा प्राणिनां पीडामुपादानादमन्यत॥
en: Having seen that his income and expenditure are the same, that Rishi who always saw both sides with equal eyes thought that if he took anything (from that king's wealth), he would injure creatures.

sa: विख्यातौ त्रिषु लोकेषु नरनारायणावृषी। कार्यार्थमवतीर्णौ तौ पृथ्वीं पुण्यप्रतिश्रयाम्॥
en: The Rishis Nara and Narayana are renowned all over the three worlds; they have descended (on earth) for the accomplishment of certain purpose on earth, which is the region for the acquisition of virtue.

sa: तान् सर्वानग्रहारेण ब्राह्मणान् वेदवादिनः। यथार्ह पूजयामि स्म पानाच्छादनभोजनैः॥
en: All those Brahmanas that were the utterers of the Vedas, I used always to worship duty with food, drink and clothes taken from stores, when a portion of them had been dedicated to Vishvadeva.

sa: अन्ये छत्रं वरूथं च बन्धुरं च तथापरे। गन्धर्वा बहुसाहस्रास्तिलशो व्यधमन् रथम्॥ ततो रथादवप्लुत्य सूतपुत्रोऽसिचर्मभृत्। विकर्णरथमास्थाय मोक्षायाश्वानचोदयत्॥
en: Some cut down his umbrella, some the wooden fender round his car and some its joints. It was thus many thousands of Gandharvas attacked his car and broke it into many pieces. When his car was thus attacked, Karna leaped from it with sword and shield in his hands. He then jumped upon the car of Vikarna and whipped the horses (to leave the field and) save himself.

sa: लोमश उवाच एवमेतन्महाबाहो पश्यन्ति परमर्षयः। सरस्वतीमिमां पुण्यां पुण्यैकशरणावृताम्॥
en: Lomasha said: O mighty-armed hero, it is as you say. Thus do great Rishis see (all the worlds). Yonder is the sacred Sarasvati, thronged by persons who consider her to be their sole refuge.

sa: सम्यग् वर्षति पर्जन्ये सस्यसम्पद उत्तमाः। निरामयाः सुधर्मिष्ठाः प्रजाधर्मपरायणाः॥
en: The clouds copiously rained and people had an abundance of harvests. They had no malice or ill will, they were devoted to the duties of their own order. They were all devoted to virtue.

sa: अयोध्यायामिक्ष्वाकुकुलोद्वहः पार्थिवः परिक्षिन्नाम मृगयामगमत्॥
en: Markandeya said : A king of Ayodhya, born in Ikshvaku's dynasty, named Parikshit (once) went out hunting.

sa: आवामिच्छावहे देव कृतमेकं त्वया विभो। अनावृतेऽस्मिन्नाकाशे वधं सुरवरोत्तम॥
en: O deity, O lord, O foremost of all the celestials, there is one thing, however, which we want to be done by you. You must kill us at a place which is absolutely uncovered.

sa: शुश्रूषा च द्विजातीनां शूद्राणां धर्म उच्यते। भैक्ष्यहोमव्रतैींनास्तथैव गुरुवासिताः॥
en: It is said that the duty of the Shudra is to serve the twice-born ones. The (Shudra) cannot beg alms, perform Homas and observe vows. They are to live in their master's house. same..

sa: तथा बहुविधाकारा प्रावृण्मेघानुनादिता। अभ्यतीता शिवा तेषां चरतां मरुधन्वसु॥
en: Thus, while the Pandavas were wandering about in dry sandy tracts at the neighbourhood of mountains the delightful rainy season so various in aspect and resounding with (the roar of) the clouds passed away.

sa: गिरानाश्वासयस्यद्य स्वां सुतामिव दुःखिताम्। वीर विक्रान्तधर्मज्ञ सत्यसंध महीपते॥
en: O hero! O you of great prowess! O you versed in righteousness! O veracious one! O lord of the earth! if you are present in this forest then, O king! show yourself unto me?

sa: याजनाध्यापनं विप्रेधर्मश्चैव प्रतिग्रहः। पालनं क्षत्रियाणां वै वैश्यधर्मश्च पोषणम्॥
en: Performing sacrifices (on behalf of others), teaching and acceptance of gifts are the (three) duties of the Brahmana. The duty of the Kshatriya is to rule and that of Vaishya is to tend (cattle).

sa: मुहूर्तादथ मे दृष्टिः प्रादुर्भूता पुनर्नवा। यया निर्मुक्तमात्मानमपश्यं लब्धचेतसम्॥
en: As he said to me, within that very moment, I acquired as if new sight; in consequence of which I saw myself possessed of true knowledge and freed from the illusions of the world.

sa: कृत्वा स पशुबन्धांश्च दीक्षितः पाण्डुनन्दनः। धर्मराजो महातेजाः सहविभिळरोचत॥
en: Having finished the rites of binding the sacrificial animals, the son of Pandu, viz., king Yudhishthira the just, gifted with great energy, the initiation being over, shone with great splendour along with those Ritvijas.

sa: तत्रोष्यं सुचिरं कालं भुक्त्वा भोगाननुत्तमान्। सहाप्सरोभिर्मुदितो रमते नन्दनादिषु॥
en: He lives there for a long time, enjoying various kinds of superior articles. Passing his time happily in the company of the Apsaras, he sports in the garden of Nandana and other delightful regions.

sa: भीमसेनार्जुनौ चैव तथा माद्रवतीसुतौ। इष्टवन्तो भविष्यन्ति त्वयीष्टवति पार्थिवे॥
en: Bhimasena and Arjuna and the two sons of Madravati will be sacrificing when you, O king, sacrifice Bhimasena and Arjuna and the two sons of Madravati will be sacrificing when you, O king, sacrifice

sa: सर्वहिंसानिवृत्ताश्च नराः सर्वसहाश्च ये। सर्वस्याश्रयभूताश्च ते नराः स्वर्गगामिनः॥
en: Those men who have abstained from all sorts of injury or harm to all creatures, who can endure everything, and who have made themselves the refuge of all creatures succeed in ascending to heaven.

sa: वैश्यापुत्रस्तु भागांस्त्रीशूद्रापुत्रस्तथाष्टमम्। सोऽपि दत्तं हरेत् पित्रा नादत्तं हर्तुमर्हति॥
en: The remaining one or the eighth share shall be taken by the son of the Shudra wife. The son of the Shudra wife, however, shall take only when the father gives but not otherwise.

sa: युधिष्ठिर उवाच अपूर्वश्च भवेत् पात्रमथवापि चिरोषितः। दूरादभ्यागतं चापि किं पात्रं स्यात् पितामह॥
en: Yudhishthira said Which among these three persons, O grandfather should be regarded as the best for making gifts, viz., one who is a thorough stranger, or one who is living with and known to the giver for a long time, or one who comes to the giver from a long distance?

sa: यजस्व विविधैर्यज्ञैर्बहुभिः स्वाप्तदक्षिणैः। देवांस्तर्पय सोमेन स्वधया च पितॄनपि॥
en: Do you (now) celebrate many a sacrifice with suitable presents to the priests; and do you please the celestials with Soma juice and the manes of your forefathers, with their due food and drink.

sa: तत्र प्रोवाच तुरगस्तं कृष्णश्वेतवालधिः। ताम्रास्यनेत्रः कौरव्य प्रज्वलन्निव तेजसा॥
en: Then there appeared to him a black horse with a white tail. His face and eyes were of a coppcry colour, O you of Kuru's race, and he secmed to blaze forth with energy.

sa: शरीरन्यासमोक्षेण मनसा निर्मलेन च। स्वप्नभूतांश्च ताल्लोकान् पश्यन्तीहापि सुव्रताः॥
en: Men who perform excellent vows see those regions which resemble the bright creations of dreams helped by their purified minds and by that (temporary) liberation which succeeds the loss of one's consciousness of body.

sa: व्यवहरश्च ते राजन् नित्यमाप्तैरधिष्ठितः॥ योज्यस्तुष्टैर्हितै राजन् नित्यं चारैरनुष्ठितः।
en: Let your laws, O king, be always administered by trusted judges placed in charge thereof, who should also be contented and of good conduct. Their acts should also be ascertained by you through spies.

sa: शूद्रां शयनमारोप्य ब्राह्मणो यात्यधोगतिम्। प्रायश्चित्तीयते चापि विधिदृष्टेन कर्मणा॥
en: A Brahmana, by knowing a Shudra woman comes by a low end in the next world. He should, having done such an act, perform expiation according to the rites laid down in the scriptures.

sa: ततो गिरिसुता दृष्ट्वा दीप्ताग्निसदृशेक्षणम्। हरं प्रणम्य शिरसा ददर्शायतलोचना॥
en: Seeing what took place, the large eyed daughter of Himavat bowed her head to Mahadeva gifted with that third eye which resembled a blazing fire. She stood there with looks fixed on her husband.

sa: द्विजातेः कस्यचित् तात तुल्यवर्णः सुतस्त्वभूत्। मतङ्गो नाम नाम्ना वै सर्वैः समुदितो गुणैः॥
en: Once on a time a Brahmana obtained a son who, though procerated by a person belonging 10 a different caste, had, however, the rites of infancy and youth performed according to the ordinances laid down for Brahmanas. The Child passed by the name of Matanga and was endued with every accomplishment.

sa: इत्युक्ते विदुरेणाथ धृतराष्ट्रोऽभिनन्द्य तान्। मनश्चक्रे महादाने कार्तिक्यां जनमेजय॥
en: After Vidura had said these words, O Janamejaya, Dhritarashtra expressed his satisfaction at them and made up his mind for making large presents on the day of full moon in the month of Kartika.

sa: स एव पूर्वं निजघान दैत्यान् स पूर्वदेवश्च बभूव सम्राट्। स भूतानां भावनो भूतभव्य: स विश्वस्यास्य जगतश्चाभिगोप्ता॥
en: It is He who formerly killed the Dailyas. It is he who is the Ancient God. It is He who ruled the Asuras in the form of their Emperor (Balin). It is He who is the Creator of all beings. It is He who is also the fulure of all created Beings. It is He who is also the protector of this universe having the seed of destruction.

sa: वसन्ति सर्वलोकेषु प्रयताः सर्वकर्मसु॥ प्राणानामीश्वरानेतान् कीर्तयन् प्रयतो नरः।
en: They live in all the worlds and attentively mark all deeds. By reciting the names of those lords of all living creatures, one always becomes gifted with righteousness and wealth and cnjoyments in profusion.

sa: क्षीरं स्रवन्ति सरितस्तथा चैवानपर्वताः॥ प्रसादाः पाण्डुराभ्राभाः शय्याश्च काञ्चनोज्ज्वला:।
en: Numerous rivers that run milk, and hills of rice and other edibles, are also there. Indeed, many palatial residences loO king like white clouds, with many beds of golden splendour, are in those regions.

sa: श्येनः पतत्रिणामादिर्यज्ञानां हुतमुत्तमम्। सरीसृपाणां सर्वेषां ज्येष्ठः सर्पो द्विजोत्तमाः॥
en: The hawk is the first of all birds. Of sacrifices the first is the pouring of clarified butter on the fire. Of all reptiles the first, O foremost of twice-born ones, is the snake.

sa: यज्ञं दीक्षां तथा होमान् यच्चान्यन्मृगयामहे। न्यायेनोपार्जिताहारा: स्वकर्माभिरता वयम्॥
en: Acquiring our food by lawful incans and observant of our respective duties, we shall seek to go through sacrificial initiations and the pouring of libations on the sacred fire and the other religious rites.

sa: आकाशादवनि प्राप्तस्ततः स पृथिवीपतिः। एतदेव पुनश्चोक्त्वा विवेश धरणीतलम्॥
en: From that moment Vasu dropped down from the sky on the Earth. After this he once more repeated his opinion, with the result that he had to go down below the earth for it.

sa: संस्कारैः संस्कृतः पूर्वं यथावच्चरितव्रतः। जातौ गुणविशिष्टायां समावर्तेत तत्त्ववित्॥
en: He who has been first purified by ceremonies, who has duly observed vows, who belongs by birth to a family of high qualifications, and who understands the Vedas, should return (from his preceptor's house).

sa: तान् स गाण्डीवनिर्मुक्तान् वज्राशनिसमप्रभान्। नाराचानच्छिनद् राजा भल्लैःसर्वास्त्रिधा द्विधा॥
en: King Babhruvahana, however, with his own broad-headed arrows, cut all those arrows, which were discharged from Gandiva and which resembled the thunderbolt of Indra in splendour, some in two, and some into three, parts.

sa: ब्रह्मणस्तु कवेः पुत्रा वारुणास्तेऽप्युदाहृताः। अष्टौ प्रसवजैर्युक्ता गुणैर्ब्रह्मविदः शुभाः॥
en: The sons of Kavi who was adopted by Brahman himself are also known as Varunas. Eight in number all of them became progenitors of races and tribes. Auspicious by nature, they all knew Brahma.

sa: भीष्म उवाच ततः कदाचिद् देवेन्द्रो दिव्यरूपवपुर्धरः। इदमन्तरमित्येवमभ्यगात् तमथाश्रमम्॥
en: Bhishma said One day the king of the celestials assuming a form of divine beauty, came to the hermitage of the Rishi, thinking that the opportunity he had been expecting had at last come.

sa: षड्भागपरिशुद्धं च कृपेर्भागमुपार्जितम्। वैश्यो ददद् द्विजातिभ्यः पापेभ्यः परिमुच्यते॥
en: Thai Vaishya who divides the produce of his fields into six equal parts and makes of gift a one of those shares to Brahmanas, succeeds by such conduct in cleansing himself from every sin.

sa: अन्धः स्यादन्धवेलायां जडः स्यादपि वा बुधः। परिहारेण तद् ब्रूयाद् यस्तेषां स्याद् व्यतिक्रमः॥
en: The eldest brother should at times not notice the acts of his younger brothers, and though possessed of wisdom should at times act as if he does not understand their acts. If the younger brothers be guilty of any sin, the eldest brother should correct them by indirect ways and means.

sa: यं पुरा पर्यवीजन्त तालवृन्तैर्वरस्त्रियः। तं गृध्राः पर्यवीजन्त दावाग्निपरिकालितम्॥
en: Alas, he had formerly been fanned with palm leaves by the fair hands of beautiful women, was fanned by vultures with their wings after he had been burnt to death in a wild fire.

sa: तत्राश्रमपदे श्रेष्ठे सर्वभूतमनोरमे। सेविते द्विजशार्दूलैर्वेदवेदाङ्गपारगैः॥ नानानियमविख्यातैर्ऋषिभिः सुमहात्मभिः। प्रविशन्नेव चापश्यं जटाचीरधरं प्रभुम्॥ तेजसा तपसा चैव दीप्यमानं यथाऽनलम्। शिष्यैरनुगतं शान्तं युवानं ब्राह्मणर्षभम्॥
en: In that foremost of hermitages, which was charming to all creatures, inhabited by many foremost of Brahmanas fully conversant with the Vedas and their branches, and by many great Rishis well-known for the difficult vows they practised, I saw, as soon as I entered a powerful Rishi with matted locks on head and dressed in rags, who seemed to shine like fire with his penances and energy. Served by his disciples and possessed of tranquil soul, that foremost of Brahmanas was young to look at.

sa: समैः सम्यक्प्रयुक्तैश्च वचनैः प्रत्ययोत्तरैः। यद्गच्छति जनश्चायं स्नेहमुत्सृज्य दुस्त्यजम्॥
en: It is, indeed, so, since influenced by his well-applied words teaching tranquility and capable of producing conviction, that man there returns to the town, casting off affection that is so hard to throw off.

sa: कार्ये व्यासक्तमनसः संकल्पो जाग्रतो ह्यपि। यद्वन्मनोरथैश्वर्यं स्वप्ने तद्वन्मनोगतम्॥
en: As the imagination of a person who is awake and engaged in acts, is due only to the creative power of the mind, similarly, the impressions in a dream belong only to the mind.

sa: चक्षुरालोचनायैव संशयं कुरुते मनः। बुद्धिरध्यवसानाय साक्षी क्षेत्रज्ञ उच्यते।
en: The senses exist for simply catching the impressions of their respective objects. Doubt is the function of the Mind. The Understanding is for ascertainment. The soul is said to be only an inactive witness.

sa: बुद्धिरध्यात्ममित्याहुर्यथावदभिदर्शिनः। बोद्धव्यमधिभूतं तु क्षेत्रज्ञश्चाधिदैवतम्॥
en: Buddhi is Spiritual; that which is to be understood is its Elemental; and Soul is its Accidental.

sa: अथ राक्षसाः सर्वं येऽभिरक्षन्ति पद्मिनीम्। प्रत्युत्थिता भगवन्तं मणिभद्रपुरोगमाः॥
en: Seeing the Rishi arrived there all the Rakshasas headed by Manibhadra who were engaged in protecting that lake full of beautiful lotuses, came out in a body for welcoming and honoring the illustrious traveller.

sa: तस्मिन् वाय्वम्बुसंघर्षे दीप्ततेजा महाबलः। प्रादुरभूदूर्ध्वशिखः कृत्वा निस्तिमिरं नमः॥
en: Then on account of the friction of wind and water, fire endued with great power and burning energy, came into being, with flames directed upwards. That fire dissipated the darkness that had covered Space.

sa: आसीदादानदण्डोऽपि वधदण्डोऽद्य वर्तते। वधेनापि न शक्यन्ते नियन्तुमपरे जनाः॥
en: Then came the punishment of fines and forfeitures. In this age, however, the punishment of death is in vogue. Wickedness has increased to such an extent that by killing one others cannot be controlled.

sa: धर्मो भवति स क्षिप्रं प्रलापस्त्वेव साधुषु। अथैतानाहुरुन्मत्तानपि चावहसन्त्युत॥
en: It cannot be gainsaid that such acts are righteous. Fools, again, hold that virtue is an empty sound among those called good. They ridicule such persons and consider them as men bereft of reason.

sa: असंसर्गो हि भूतेषु संसर्गो वा विनाशिषु। कस्मै क्रियेत कल्प्येत निश्चयः कोऽत्र तत्त्वतः॥
en: If Liberation means dissociation from all objects of pleasure or an association with objects that are not lasting, why should then men cherish a desire for action or having set themselves to action, continue to find out the necessary means for the accomplishment of desired ends? What then is the truth.

sa: सत्त्वं रजस्तमश्चेति देवासुरगुणान् विदुः। सत्त्वं देवगुणं विद्यादितरावासुरौ गुणौ॥
en: It should be known that the qualities of Goodness, Darkness, and Ignorance belong to the gods and the Asuras. Goodness is the quality of the gods; while the two others belong to the Asuras.

sa: ऋग्वेदपाठपठितं व्रतमेतद्धि दुश्चरम्। सुपर्णाच्चाप्यधिगतो धर्म एष सनातनः॥ वायुना द्विपदां श्रेष्ठ कथितो जगदायुषा। वायोः सकाशात् प्राप्तश्च ऋषिभिर्विघसाशिभिः॥
en: This religion has been referred to in the Rigveda. The duties it enjoins are extremely difficult of observance. From the Rishi Suparna, this eternal religion was acquired, O foremost of men, by the wind god, that sustainer of the lives of all creatures in the universe. The god of wind communicated it to such Rishis as live upon the remnants of sacrificial offerings after feeding guests and others.

sa: अहो पुत्रवियोगेन मृतशून्योपसेवनात्। क्रोशतां सुभृशं दुःखं विवत्सानां गवामिव॥
en: Alas, I had thought that the grief felt by men bewailing aloud for the death of a child and for the corpse on a creinatorium, is great like that of kine bereft of calves.

sa: पितामहोऽपि भगवांस्तस्माद् देवादनन्तरः॥ कथं स न विजानीयात् प्रभावममितौजसः।
en: Is the illustrious Grandfather of all the worlds any way different from or inferior to the great Narayana? How then it is that he was unacquainted with the power of Narayana of great energy?"

sa: दातारः संगृहीता आर्याः करुणवेदिनः। महाप्रसादा ऋजवो दृढभक्ता जितेन्द्रिया:॥
en: They were all charitable and economical of respectable conduct; and endued with mercy. They were full of mercy, endued with simplicity of conduct, steadfast in faith, and had their passions under complete control. smear

sa: प्रभवद्भि: पुरा दायानहेभ्यः प्रतियादितान्॥ नाभ्यवर्तन्त नास्तिक्या वर्तन्तः सम्भवेष्वपि।
en: Those of their ancestors who were very rich had made gifts of wealth to worthy persons. The descendants of the donors, even when in affluence began to take back, for their unbelief, those gifts.

sa: पञ्चधारणके ह्यस्मिन् शरीरे जीवितं कुतः। तेषामन्यतराभावाच्चतुर्णां नास्ति संशयः॥
en: How we can say that there is life in this animal body which is composed of the five elements? If one of those clements disappear, the dissolution of the other four is brought about.

sa: यथा ज्ञाने परिचयः कर्तव्यस्तत्फलार्थिना। तथा धर्मे परिचयः कर्तव्यस्तत्फलार्थिना॥
en: As one desirous of acquiring the fruits of knowledge, should busy himself with the acquisition of knowledge, so one desirous of acquiring the fruits of Virtue should be busy with the acquisition of Virtue.

sa: लब्धवानीप्सिता कामानहं वै पाण्डुनन्दन। तथात्वमपि शद्धि सर्वान् कामानवाप्स्यसि॥
en: As the reward of this, I acquired the fruition of all my wishes, O son of Pandu! You will also by reciting this same hymn, get from Sharva the fruition of all your wishes.

sa: तं दृष्ट्वा पुरुषादाभमपध्वस्तं क्षयागतम्। अभिज्ञाय द्विजो व्रीडत्रिदं वाक्यमथाब्रवीत्॥
en: Seeing that man who looked like a cannibal and who had fallen away from the pure practices of his caste, and entering his house, the newly-arrived guest, recognising him, O king, said these words

sa: एषा तत्त्वचतुर्विंशा सर्वाकृतिषु वर्तते। यां ज्ञात्वा नाभिशोचन्ति ब्राह्मणास्तत्त्वदर्शिनः॥
en: These form the twenty-four topics that exist in the forms of all living creatures. By understanding these properly. these properly. Brahmanas endued with insight into the truth have never to give way to sorrow.

sa: नैतज्ज्ञात्वा पुमान् स्त्री वा पुनर्भवमवाप्नुते। अभवप्रतिपत्त्यर्थमेतद् धर्मं विधीयते॥
en: Whatever the sex may be, male or female, the person who acquires the knowledge of Brahma hath never to go through re-births. This duty (of Yoga) has been described for acquiring Liberation from re-birth.

sa: अथापीमासु संज्ञासु लौकिकीषु प्रतिष्ठसे। अभिषङ्गावरोधाभ्यां बद्धस्त्वं प्राकृतो यथा॥
en: It appears that you are endued with only worldly knowledge, and that like an ordinary man of the world, you are bound by the fetters of touch and wives and mansions and the like.

sa: तथास्यातिथयः पूज्या हव्यकव्यवहाः सदा। वेदविद्याव्रतस्नाताः श्रोत्रिया वेदपारगाः॥ स्वधर्मजीविनो दान्ताः क्रियावन्तस्तपस्विनः। तेषां हव्यं च कव्यं चाप्यहणार्थं विधीयते॥
en: He should always adore such guests who present sacrificial offerings, who are cleansed by Vedic learning, who observe excellent vows, who are high-born and conversant with the scriptures, who are self-controlled, mindful of all religious acts, and devoted to penances. The scriptures hold that what is offered to the gods and the departed manes in sacrifices and religious rites, is meant for the service of guests like these.

sa: आकिञ्चन्यं सुसंतोषो निराशीस्त्वमचापलम्। एतदाहुः परं श्रेय आत्मज्ञस्य जितात्मनः॥
en: A perfect disregard for all (worldly) things, perfect contentment, abandonment of hope of every sort, and patience,-these form the highest good of one who has governed his senses and acquired a knowledge of self.

sa: आत्मनो व्यापिनो ज्ञानमिदं पुत्रानुशासनम्। प्रयताय प्रवक्तव्यं हितायानुगताय च॥
en: This knowledge of the all-pervading Soul should be delivered to one's son. It should be inculcated upto one who is of controlled Senses, who is honest in conduct, and. that is docile or submissive.

sa: अधीत्य वेदानखिलान् गुरुशुश्रूषणे रतः। गुरूणामनृणो भूत्वा समावर्तेत यज्ञवित्॥
en: Having read all the Vedas and having showed submission towards his preceptor while living with him, and having paid the preceptor's fee, the youth should return home with a perfect knowledge of all sacrifices.

sa: इतीमं हृदयग्रन्थिं बुद्धिभेदमयं दृढम्। विमुच्य सुखमासीत न शोचेच्छिन्नसंशयः॥
en: One should thus solve the knotty question which is capable of shaking the understanding by doubt, and thereby acquire happiness. When that doubt will be removed, one will no longer : have to grieve.

sa: गालव उवाच सगणो दैवतश्रेष्ठस्तत्रैवान्तरधीयत। विश्वामित्राभ्यनुज्ञातो ह्यहं पितरमागतः॥ अब्रवीन्मां ततो माता दुःखिता रुदती भृशम्। कौशिकेनाभ्यनुज्ञातं पुत्रं वेदविभूषितम्॥
en: Galava said Formerly I studied from my preceptor Vishvamitra. Getting his permission I started for home the object of seeing; my father. My widowed mother stricken with sorrow and, weeping bitterly, said tu me Alas, your father will never see his son who, endued with Vedic knowledge, has been allowed by his preceptor to come home and who, having all the graces of youth, is endued with selfcontrol.

sa: पृथ्वीमिमां यद्यपि रत्नपूर्णां दद्यान्न देयं त्विदमव्रताय। जितेन्द्रियायैतदसंशयं ते भवेत् प्रदेयं परमं नरेन्द्र॥
en: This great knowledge should never be given, even if he gives in exchange the whole Earth full of gems and riches of every sort, to one that is not obscrvant of any vows and restraints. Forsooth, however, O king, this knowledge should be imparted to one who has conquered his senses.

sa: ब्रह्मण्योऽयं पुरा भूत्वा सत्यवादी जितेन्द्रियः। अभ्यसूयद् ब्राह्मणानामुच्छिष्टश्चास्पृशद् घृतम्॥
en: Formerly he was devoted to the Brahmanas. He was truthful and had mastered his passions. Latterly, however, he began to entertain feelings of animosity towards the Brahmanas and touched clarified butter with impure hands.

sa: ततो देवाधिदेवः स योगात्मा योगसारिथः। योगमास्थाय भगवांस्तदा भरतसत्तम॥
en: Then that Supreme God of all the gods, having Yoga for his soul and companion, became immersed in Yoga, O chief of the Bharatas, and began to roar terribly agitating those Daityas and Danavas.

sa: अहंकारिकमध्यात्ममाहुस्तत्त्वनिदर्शिनः। अभिमानोऽधिभूतं तु रुद्रश्चात्राधिदैवतम्॥
en: Ahankara is Spiritual; that which is to be vanity is its Elemental; and Rudra is its Accidental.

sa: पूज्यमाना द्विजैर्नित्यं मोदमाना गृहे रताः। याजनाध्यापनरताः श्रीमन्तो लोकविश्रुताः॥
en: Happily spending their days in the domestic mode of life, they were treated by the Brahmanas with great reverence. Possessed of great fame and prosperity, they were engaged in teaching and officiating in sacrifices.

sa: तस्मात् सत्यव्रताचारः सत्ययोगपरायणः। सत्यागमः सदा दान्तः सत्येनैवान्तकं जयेत्॥
en: For these reasons, one should practise the vow of Truth; one should devote himself too Truth; one should accept Truth for one's Veda; and controlling is senses, one should defcat the Death by Truth.

sa: मेधातिथिर्महाप्राज्ञो गौतमस्तपसि स्थितः। विमृश्य तेन कालेन पन्याः संस्थाव्यतिक्रमम्॥
en: Gifted with great wisdom, Medhatithi of Gautama's race. Practising penances, returned, convinced, after having meditated for that long time, of the impropriety of the punishment he had ordered to be inflicted upon his wife.

sa: वृत्रस्य रुधिराच्चैव शिखण्डाः पार्थ जज्ञिरे। द्विजातिभिरभक्ष्यास्ते दीक्षितैश्च तपोधनैः॥
en: From the blood of Vritra, O son of Pritha, were born high-crested cocks. Therefore, those fowls are unclean (as food) for the twice-born ones, and those ascetics that have undergone the rite of initiation.

sa: विवक्षता च सद्वाक्यं धर्मं सूक्ष्ममवेक्षता। सत्यां वाचमहिंस्रां च वदेदनपवादिनीम्॥ कल्कापेतामपरुषामनृशंसामपैशुनाम्। ईदृगल्पं च वक्तव्यमविक्षिप्तेन चेतसा॥ वाक्प्रबद्धो हि संसारो विरागाद् व्याहरेद् यदि। बुद्ध्याप्यनुगृहीतेन मनसा कर्म तामसम्॥ रजोभूतैर्हि करणैः कर्मणि प्रतिपद्यते। स दुःखं प्राप्य लोकेऽस्मिन् नरकायोपपद्यते। तस्मान्मनोवाक्शरीरै राचरेद् धैर्यमात्मनः॥
en: With the help of the injunctions of the Shrutis and of continued efforts calculated to bring success, Knowledge is sure to originate. One who is desirous of saying good words or observing a religion which is purged off of all impurities, should speak only truth which is not fraught with any malice or censure. One who has got a sound heart should speak words which are not fraught with dishonesty, which are not harsh, which are not cruel, which are not evil, and which are not characterised by garrulity. The universe is bound in words. If a person disposed to renunciation he should proclaim, with a humble mind and a cleansed understanding, his own evil deeds. He who performs action, urged there to by propensities pervaded by the quality of Darkness, suffers much misery in this world and at la

sa: यत्रागमयमानानामसत्कारेण पृच्छताम्। प्रब्रूयाद् ब्रह्मणो धर्मं त्यजेत् तं देशमात्मवान्॥
en: The pious men should leave that place where a Brahmana describes duties to disciples desirous of acquiring knowledge, as based on reasons, of the Soul, but who do not reverentially enquire after such knowledge.

sa: सांख्यदर्शनमेतावत् परिसंख्यानुदर्शनम्। सांख्याः प्रकुर्वते चैव प्रकृतिं च प्रचक्षते॥
en: This much, O king, is an account of the Sankhya philosophy. The Sankhyas call Nature the cause of the universe, and merging all the are grosser principles into the Intelligence beyind the Supreme Soul.

sa: आकर्णपलित: श्यामो वयसाशीतिपञ्चकः। रणे पर्यचरद् द्रोणो वृद्धः षोडशवर्षवत्॥
en: With his hoary locks flowering down to his ears and of a dark complexion and full eightyfive years of age, Drona then careered on the field with the agility of a boy of sixteen.

sa: न चापि कामान् कौरव्य निधाय हृदये पुमान्। अस्मद्विधः प्रवर्तेत मा मां त्वमभिशङ्किथाः॥
en: O descendant of the Kuru race, no person, who is like ourselves, ever engages himself in the execution of my duties, after having reflected in the heart such an insult. Do not doubt me (my prowess). In the battle, you should not at all attach such a great insult to me.

sa: स शरैश्चित्रितो राजा चित्रमाल्यधरो युवा। युवेव समरेऽशोभद्गोष्ठीमध्ये स्वलंकृतः॥
en: That youthful prince, wearing an wonderful appearance with the shafts and putting on handsome garlands, shone in the field of battle, like an youth, excellently decked with ornaments, in the midst of an assembly.

sa: तमारुरुधू देवेशं तुष्टुवः परमर्षयः। गन्धर्वा दैवसङ्घाश्च तथैवाप्सरसां गणाः॥
en: The great Rishis, the Gandharvas, the whole body of the celestials, as well as the different tribes of the Apsaras praised that Lord of the gods, when he was desirous to ascend the car.

sa: रभिघ्नतां चापततां जवेन। वक्त्राण्यकाशन्त तदा नराणां वाय्वीरितानीव महाम्बुजानि॥
en: The faces, of the combatants who were trembling by the impetuosity of their speed and rushing furiously against their enemies striking them down, shone at that time like great lotuses shaken by the wind.

sa: इतिहासयजुर्वेदो पृष्ठरक्षौ बभूवतुः। दिव्या वाचश्च विद्याश्च परिपार्श्वचराः स्थिताः॥
en: All histories and the Yajurveda became the guards of the back of the car; and all divine speeches and the and the different branches of knowledge placed themselves on all sides of the car.

sa: चक्ररक्षौ तु पाञ्चाल्यौ युधामन्युत्तमौजसौ। नार्जुनं जहतुयुद्धे पाल्यमानौ किरीटिना।३१॥
en: The two Panchala chiefs, Yudhamanyu and Uttamanjas, who were the guards of the wheels of the car (of Arjuna), did not forsake him in battle, as they were supported by the diademdecked one (Arjuna.)

sa: गन्धर्वयक्षासुरसिद्धसंघाः समागमन्नप्सरसश्च सर्वाः। तद् देवगन्धर्वसमाकुलं च यक्षासुरेन्द्राप्सरसां गणैश्च॥
en: The field of battle, thronged with the celestials, the Gandharvas, the Yakshas, the Siddhas, the Apsaras and the spirits of the dead combatants about to enter the celestials regions, appeared like a second heaven.

sa: वासुदेवोऽपि धर्मात्मा करिष्यत्यात्मनः क्षमम्। श्रेयो ह्यपदिशत्येष लोकस्य किमुतात्मनः॥
en: The high-souled son of Vasudeva will look after his own safety. Indeed he is competent to protect all the worlds; what to speak of his own self; it is useless to give him advise.

sa: बृहन्तः सुमहेष्वासः कृतास्त्रो युद्धदुर्मदः॥ दुःशासनेन विक्रम्य गमितो यमसादनम्।
en: Brihanta, that great bowman, who was well acquainted with the use of weapons and most invincible in battle, was sent to the region of Yama by Dushasana showing forth his prowess in the field.

sa: गजा रथाश्वाः पुरुषाश्च संघशः परस्परघ्नाः परिपेतुराहवे। परस्परं प्रस्खलिताः समाहता भृशं निपेतुर्बहुभाषिणो हताः॥
en: The elephant, the cars, the horses and men, that had thronged together, having been struck by one another, fell down on the field of battle. So also the soldiers, extolling one another highly, were deeply struck by one another and slain; and with tottering steps they fell down upon the ground.

sa: ततस्तौ रभसौ युद्धे भ्रातरौ भ्रातरं युधि। शरैर्ववृषतुोरैर्महामेघो यथाऽचलम्॥
en: Then, O king, those two brothers, greatly active in battle, began to throw terrible shafts in ceaseless torrents upon their cousins like two great masses of thick clouds pouring their contents on the hills.

sa: आददानस्य विशिखान् संदधानस्य चाशुगान्। विकर्षतो मुञ्चतश्च नान्तरं ददृशुर्जनाः॥
en: So quickly did he then shot his arrows that people could not mark when he took them out of his quiver, placed them on his bow-string, drew the string back and let them off.

sa: दारितान् द्रौणिनां बाणैर्भृशं विक्षतविग्रहान्। जहि मातुल कौन्तेयानसुरानिव पावकिः॥
en: (They) are already deeply wounded, their bodies are mangled with shafts by the son of Drona. O uncle, (now) destroy the sons of Kunti, as the son of Agni (i.e., Kartikeya) slew the Asuras.

sa: दृष्ट्वार्जुनहतान् नागान् पतितान् पर्वतोपमान्। रथमार्गविघातार्थ व्यायुधः प्रविवेश ह॥
en: Then deprived as he was of his weapons, beholding the huge mountain-like elephant slain by Arjuna lying on the field, he entered into their midst for impeding the progress of the car of Karna.

sa: आनर्तवासी हृदिकात्मजोऽसौ महारथः सात्वतानां वरिष्ठः। स्वयं भोजः कृतवर्मा कृतास्त्रो व्यवस्थितो योद्धुकामस्त्वदर्थे। ८॥
en: That mighty car-warrior Kritavarman, that son of Hridika, the dweller of the country of Anarta, the most exalted of the Satvatas, that chief of the Bhojas himself is still staying in the field of battle, desirous of fighting for your sake, as he is well acquainted with the use of weapons.

sa: द्विरदस्यन्दनाश्वेभ्यः पेतुर्वीरा द्विषद्धताः। विमानेभ्यो यथा क्षीणे पुण्ये स्वर्गसदस्तथा॥
en: Smitten by the enemies, the heroic warriors fell down from the elephants, the cars and horses, even as the dwellers of heaven fall down from the celestial balloons, when their virtues are entirely spent.

sa: ततः शरशतज्वाल: सेनाकक्षं महारथः॥ द्रौणिर्ददाह समरे कक्षमग्निर्यथा वने।
en: Then the great car-warrior, Drona's son, burnt down, as it were, the Pandava troops in the battle with the flames of his arrows, just as the forest fire burns the dry hays and straws.

sa: तौ पुनः संन्यवर्तेतां प्राणधूतपणे रणे॥ निपीडयन्तौ बाणौधैः परस्परममर्षिणौ।
en: Those two (warriors), who resisted each other, baffled the arrowy showers of each other and could not tolerate each other, were engaged in the game of battle in which the wager was life itself.

sa: स चोच्छिष्टभूतः काको वैश्यपुत्रैः कुमारकैः॥ सदृशान् पक्षिणादृप्तः श्रेयसञ्चाधिचिक्षिपे।
en: Thus fed with the leavings of the food by those sons of the Vaishya the crow became arrogant and began to think light of all birds who were equal to him or even superior.

sa: ततो युगान्ताभ्रसमखनं महन्महेन्द्रचापप्रतिमं च गाण्डिवम्। चकर्ष दोर्ध्या विहसन् भृशं ययौ दहंस्त्वदीयान् यमराष्ट्रवर्धनः॥
en: Arjuna bending his with the force of his arms, his terrible bow the Gandiva that resembled the bow of Indra and of which the twang was as loud as roar of clouds at the end of a Yuga, went on carnaging your soldiers and adding to the population of Death's domain.

sa: संजय उवाच एवमुक्त्वार्जुनं राजा त्रिभिर्मर्मातिगैः शरैः। अभ्यविध्यन्महावेगैश्चतुर्भिश्चतुरो हयान्॥
en: Sanjaya said Having thus spoken, the king pierced Arjuna with three shafts capable of penetrating to the very vitals; and then with another four arrows of great velocity, he pierced the latter's four steeds.

sa: संजय उवाच एवमुक्तो महाबाहुपकेतुर्महायशाः। युयुधानं समुज्सृज्य रणे प्रायमुपाविशत्॥
en: Sanjaya said Thus spoken to (by Arjuna), the illustrious and mighty-armed Bhurisravas bearing the device of a sacrificial stake on his banner, let Yuyudhana go and desired to enter upon the performance of Praya-Yoga.

sa: सर्वभारसह शश्वद् गन्धमाल्यार्चितं महत्॥ वज्रेणास्त्रेण संयोज्य विधिवत् कुरुनन्दनः।
en: That dreadful arrow became capable of bearing any strain. It used always to be worshipped with perfumes and garlands of flowers. Duly charging it was the impetuosity of the thunder-bolt, that descendant of Kuru.

sa: एवं प्रयाते देवेश लोकानामभयंकरे। तुष्टमासीजगत् सर्वे देवताश्च नरोत्तम॥
en: O foremost of persons, when that boongiving Lord, who destroys the terrors of all creatures of the entire universe, was thus proceeding onwards; the whole universe, as also all the celestials became highly satisfied.

sa: न्यवारयत तेजस्वी नकुलचित्रमार्गवित्। स सर्वतो निवार्यैनं शरजालेन पीडयन्॥
en: The latter (Nakula) endued with energy and versed in the diverse ccurses of a chariot, restrained your son. But your son again, resisting Nakula on all sides and afflicting him, with his arrowy showers.

sa: स्तोत्रादयश्च राजेन्द्र वषट् कारस्तथैव त। ओंकारच मुखे राजन्नतिशोभकरोऽभवत्॥
en: O king, the hymns and others, as also the principal Vedic sounds, namely, Vashatkara, stood round the car. And O monarch, the syllable Om, having placed at the front of it, became greatly hand-some.

sa: तैविमुक्तैः शरशतैश्छादितं गगनं तदा। शलभानां यथा वातैस्तद्वदासीद् विशांमते॥
en: Then, O ruler of earth, the welkin, covered over as it was with the hundreds of arrows shot by both of them, looked even as it was covered over with the swarms of locusts,

sa: ततोऽभिजघ्नुः कुपिताः परस्परं शरैस्तदाञ्जोगतिभिः सुतेजनैः॥ सुराः पुरा देवगणैस्तथाऽऽहवे।
en: Like the Devas (celestials) and the Asuras in the old days, the Kuru warriors and the Srinjayas, coming wrathfully in contact with each other, went on killing one another with powerful and straight shafts.

sa: एकनाह्वा त्वसौ वीरश्चरन्भूमिं बुभुक्षितः। व्यात्तास्यो भक्षयेल्लोकान्संवृद्ध इव पावकः॥
en: And for a single day, that hero, coming under the influence of hunger, shall range the earth, opening his mouth wide open, and devouring people like a fire that has spread far and wide.

sa: असकृत् तैर्महाभागैर्वानरैर्बलसंयुतैः। प्रदक्षिणीकृता भूमिर्वायुमार्गानुसारिभिः॥
en: And those great and powerful monkeys, coursing in the air, have again and again circumambulated the earth.

sa: अत्र मन्युर्न कर्तव्यः कोपये त्वां न भीषये। समर्थो ह्यसि वीर्येण सुराणामपि निग्रहे॥
en: In this matter, you ought not to grow wroth, I only arouse your wrath, and do not endeavour to frighten you. You can subdue even the celestials by your prowess. *i.e. You ought not to be angry with me; for I do not frighten you, but rouse your wrath against Ravana.

sa: पितामहेन प्रीतेन देवदानवराक्षसैः। रावणस्याभयं दत्तं मनुष्येभ्यो न याचितम्॥
en: The great Patriarch, being pleased conferred upon Rāvaņa the boon that no fear would proceed to him from the celestials, the Dānavas or the Rākşasas-but he did not beg of him, security from men.

sa: स्थितान्पश्यसि यानेतान्मत्तानिव महाद्विपान्। न्यग्रोधानिव गाङ्गेयान्सालान्हैमवतानिव॥ एते दुष्प्रसहा राजन्बलिनः कामरूपिणः। दैत्यदानवसंकाशा युद्धे देवपराक्रमाः॥
en: Those, o king, whom you see stationed, resembling mad elephants, like to nyagrodhas* belonging to the Gangă, like to Sālas in the Himavān, are incapable of being borne, they are possessed of strength, and able to wear forms at will; resembling deities and Dänavas, and like the gods in conflict. *Banians.

sa: विपुलपरिघवान्स कुम्भकर्णो रिपुनिधनाय विनिःसृतो महात्मा। कपिगणभयमाददत्सुभीमं प्रभुरिव किंकरदण्डवान्युगान्ते॥
en: And issuing forth for destroying the foe, the high-souled Kumbhakarņa, equipped with a tremendous bludgeon, struck extreme terror into the monkey-ranks, like to the Lord armed with the Fatal rod at the Universal wreck.

sa: संनद्धः कवची खङ्गी सशरी वामचापभृत्। रामपादावुपस्पृश्य हृष्टः सौमित्रिरब्रवीत्॥
en: And donning on his mail, and putting on his armour and his sword, and furnished with arrows, and a bow in his left hand, Sumitrā's son, touching Rāma's feet, feeling elated, addressed Rāma, saying.

sa: स पुष्पवर्षैरवकीर्यमाणो धृतातपत्रः शितशूलपाणिः। महोत्कटः शोणितगन्धमत्तो विनिर्ययौ दानवदेवशत्रुः॥
en: And strewn with blossoms, and, with an umbrella held over him, that exceedingly terrible enemy of the Deities and the Dănvas, wielding a dz.: in his hand-went out maddened with the smell of blood.

sa: नमस्कृत्वा समुद्राय मारुतिर्भीमविक्रमः। राघवार्थे परं कर्म समीहत परंतपः॥
en: Bowing down to the Ocean, that subduer of enemies, the Wind-god's son, endowed with dreadful prowess, began to ponder over the mighty mission with which he had been entrusted in the interests of Rāghava.

sa: त्यजेमां नरशार्दूल बुद्धिं वैक्लव्यकारिणीम्॥ शोकसंजननीं चिन्तां तुल्यां बाणैश्चमूमुखे।
en: O foremost of men, cast off this train of thought tending to overwhelm your understanding, this anxiety giving birth to grief, and resembling the shafts of foes in the van of the embattled forces.

sa: सोऽपि प्रवृद्धस्तान्सर्वान्हरीन्संप्रेत्यपूजयत्। हनूमान्सत्त्वसंपन्नो यथार्हमनुकूलतः॥
en: And Hanumăn, gifted with strength, honoured the seniors each as he deserved in consideration of his lineage.

sa: जनस्थानवधं श्रुत्वा निहतौ खरदूषणौ। ततस्त्वमर्षापहृता जानकी रावणेन तु॥
en: And having heard of the destruction of the Rākşasas of Janasthāna and of Khara and Duşaņa, the illusive Rāvana, assuming shapes at will, beguiling Rāma, it the forest, stole away his consort-the Janaka's daughter.

sa: राक्षसाधम रामस्य भार्याममिततेजसः। इक्ष्वाकुवंशनाथस्य स्नुषां दशरथस्य च ॥
en: O worst of Rākşasas, having used improper speech towards the wife of Rāma of measureless prowess, and the daughter-in-law of Dasaratha, lord of the Ikşvāku line, why had you not your tongue fallen off?

sa: वार्यमाणः सुसंस्क्रुद्धः सुहृद्भिर्हितबुद्धिभिः। अभ्यधावत संक्रुद्धः खे ग्रहो रोहिणीमिव।॥
en: And dissuaded by his friends endowed with good intelligence, he wrought up with high wrath, darted (against Sītā), even as an enraged planet' rush against Rohinr in the firmament. 1. Kuja etc. 2. Hesperus.

sa: चपलस्येह कृत्यानि सहसानुप्रधावतः। क्षिप्रमन्ये प्रपद्यन्ते क्रौञ्चस्य खमिव द्विजाः॥
en: Even as the fowls of the air enter the hole in the Krauñca, enemies find and easy entrance into the short comings of him that is fickle and that rush into act without heed.

sa: ते शूलशरनिस्त्रिंशविविधायुधपाणयः। आपतेयुर्विमर्देऽस्मिन् वेगेनोद्वेगकारणात्॥
en: They, greatly agitated, shall with vehemence arrive here, armed with dirts, arrow, scimitars and various other weapons.

sa: भिन्नातपत्रं पतमानशस्त्रं शरैरपध्वस्तविनीतवेषम्। विनिःसृतान्त्रं भयलोलनेत्रं बलं तदुन्मत्ततरं बभूव॥
en: The forces having their umbrellas rent, their arms falling off, their goodly garments scattered, their entrails coming out and their eyes rolling, became incapable of distinguishing their own party from that of the foe.

sa: विन्दानुविन्दावावन्त्यौ काम्बोजश्च सुदक्षिणः॥ वाम पार्वं समाश्रित्य द्रोणपुत्राग्रतः स्थिताः।
en: Vinda and Anuvinda of the kingdom of Avanti and Sudakshina, the ruler of the two Kambojas, took up their positions in the left flank placing themselves in front of the division of Drona's son.
